title: Glasthule
html_source: Glasthule (/ɡlæs.θuːl/; Irish: Glas Tuathail, meaning “Toole’s Streamlet”) is a suburb of Dublin, Ireland. It is along Dublin’s East Coast, between Dún Laoghaire and Dalkey.
